name: Delivered/prescribed exposure
definition: Eligible measured/estimated effluent divided by integrated intended effluent over same wall-time and weight basis
limitations: Report numerator/denominator, unknown coverage and exclusions; not adequacy or patient outcome.

name: Downtime
definition: Union confirmed stopped minutes / explicit intended support minutes
limitations: Separate unknown minutes, planned/unplanned reason and modality; avoid duplicate events.

name: Filter life
definition: Median/distribution of connected and actual running hours per circuit
limitations: Censor open circuits; stratify clot/access/planned change; no survival claim from lifespan alone.

name: Electrolyte adverse events
definition: Locally defined verified K/Mg/phosphate/Ca/Na events per eligible support exposure
limitations: Version definitions and sample quality; unknown monitoring is missing, not zero events.

name: Temperature/hemodynamic events
definition: Eligible observed adverse events per session/support time
limitations: M7 sources/actual rescue actions linked; no causal attribution from timing alone.

name: Medication review completion
definition: Signed due renal-dose reviews completed / eligible triggered review tasks
limitations: Separate deferred/unknown/overdue and denominator changes; include M6 antibiotic owner.

name: Calcium monitoring coverage
definition: Eligible paired/site-specific monitoring completed / protocol-required checks
limitations: Distinguish systemic/postfilter/total; record lateness and unavailable tests.

name: Access complications
definition: Verified device-related events / defined catheter exposure
limitations: M12 canonical episodes; no duplicate counting across modules.

name: Native recovery
definition: Reviewed recovery state at specified follow-up / eligible AKI episodes
limitations: Missing follow-up and death competing outcomes explicit; no falling-on-KRT creatinine proxy.

name: AKI follow-up
definition: Confirmed appropriate plan/completed encounter / eligible discharge episodes
limitations: Plan and completion are separate; stratify continuing dialysis and time window.

name: Data quality
limitations: Show field-specific missing/conflicting proportion; no composite safety badge.

name: Review burden
definition: Actionable acknowledged concerns, false-positive review and response latency
limitations: No silent threshold tuning; prospective monitoring and clinical review before changes.
